table.hasAdvancedHint: rule changes headers, delay, or response status

form.localFileHint: leave empty to pass the request through to the real server and only apply the headers/delay/status below. for regex rules you can use $1, $2… — match groups are substituted

rules.importConfirm: replace current rules with the file's contents?
rules.importInvalidFormat: this file doesn't look like a FileSwitcher rules export

settings.logStorageLimitHint: how many recent log entries are kept separately for "matched" and "passed"
settings.portHint: the port the local proxy server runs on — point your browser's or system's traffic at it
settings.sudoersAlertTitle: the proxy asks for a password on every start/stop
settings.sudoersAlertDescription: allow networksetup to run without a password — one system authorization dialog, then no more password prompts for starting/stopping the proxy.
settings.sudoersInstallSuccess: done: starting/stopping the proxy will no longer ask for a password
settings.certNotGeneratedAlertDescription: start the proxy and open http://mitm.it in your browser so mitmproxy can generate a CA certificate, then trust it.
settings.firefoxWarningTitle: Firefox is not supported in the MVP
settings.firefoxWarningDescription: Firefox uses its own certificate store (NSS), not the system Keychain. import the certificate manually via about:preferences#privacy → Certificates.

onboarding.title: welcome to FileSwitcher
onboarding.intro: to make file substitution work in your browser, complete a few steps:

addRule.title: add a rule
addRule.description: in the Rules panel on the right, specify a URL and a local file

openMitm.title: open mitm.it
openMitm.description: with the proxy active, open http://mitm.it in your browser

downloadCert.title: download the certificate
downloadCert.description: download the certificate for your OS (macOS)

trustCert.title: trust the certificate
trustCert.description: in Settings, click «Install automatically», or trust it manually via Keychain Access
